name: bld3_rank_pow_card_stabilizes
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) : Matrix.rank (A ^ (Fintype.card ι + 1)) = Matrix.rank (A ^ Fintype.card ι)
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K), Matrix.rank (A ^ (Fintype.card ι + 1)) = Matrix.rank (A ^ Fintype.card ι)
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld2_rank_pow_convex: Fitting-type stabilisation: the drops d_k = rank A^k - rank A^(k+1) are non-negative and, by convexity, non-increasing; if d_n > 0 with n = card ι then d_0,...,d_n ≥ 1 and rank A^0 = n ≥ n + 1, contradiction.
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] (ι : Type u_2) [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K), (A ^ (Fintype.card ι + 1)).rank = (A ^ Fintype.card ι).rank
